entities.summary: Rudy Héctor Pemberton Pérez is a Dominican former professional baseball outfielder. He played parts of three seasons in Major League Baseball, from 1995 through 1997, for the Detroit Tigers (1995) and Boston Red Sox (1996–1997), playing mainly as a right fielder. He also played for the Seibu Lions in Japan at the end of 1997 and in 1998, and for the Kia Tigers in Korea in 2002. Listed at 6' 1", 185 lb., he batted and threw right-handed.
